parts.description: A wedge-shaped slice of a mango with bright orange flesh and a thin, multi-colored skin. The exposed flesh has a slightly fibrous and juicy texture.
parts.reasoning: The object is a single slice of a fresh mango. It consists of soft, water-dense organic tissue (the flesh) and a thin outer skin. The total mass is relatively small, estimated at 50 grams for a typical slice. The density is very close to water (1000 kg/m^3) since fresh fruit is mostly water. Friction is modeled as moderate to high because the wet, sticky flesh and the skin both provide significant grip on typical surfaces. Restitution is low because the soft, fibrous flesh absorbs impacts rather than bouncing. For rigid body simulation in Isaac Sim, a standard convex hull is appropriate due to its simple wedge shape. Given its small size, standard CCD and offset settings are used, but compliant contacts might be beneficial if simulating the slight squishiness of the flesh during handling.
